narrative.details:
When you first came to me, I knew that you would turn out to be one of my finest pupils! It was without hesitancy that you gave up a trinket of some power to McGavan. You did this only so that you could meet me. Such blind faith and devotion to the craft should be rewarded.

You have attained expertise over blacksmithing, adventurer. Reap the rewards!
narrative.objectives: Claim your reward from Galvan the Ancient!
narrative.offerRewardText: It is only fitting that you receive a trinket of far greater power than the one you sacrificed to get here. Use it in good health, adventurer.

chain.subtitle: 10 quests from level 40 to 50, 35,250 XP in all.

quests.name: Did You Lose This?
